set.body: d63cf3b8 native archive/12g complete production court and full canonical landing gate pass. Additional8g full-cohort UI saved the compact archive and drew reports but failed during BundleFiles.assemble -> BundleTables.comparisons -> ResultTable.of -> TableDigest.ofUtf8 -> Utf8Lenient.apply with Java heap space. Exact failure generation native-cohort-d63cf3b8-8g-r2 is preserved; only its failed JVM was terminated. Table hashing currently buffers the entire UTF-8 representation before hashing; stream encoded bytes into existing Sha256Core.Hasher, preserving every byte and historical surrogate behavior. No heap, archive budget, timeout or tolerance increase. Prove legacy/cross-platform digest identity, mutation/conformance and actual8g application save/reopen/export with complete CSV field/byte checks. Keep parent capacity close-out open until fixed and landed.
